program.name: ndm_bandpass
program.help:
Band-pass filter a .dat file (an alternative to ndm_hipass for spike extraction).
Combines a non-linear median high-pass, which preserves spike waveform shape, with a linear-phase FIR low-pass that removes noise above the spike band. The result is written to the .fil file, exactly like ndm_hipass, so downstream spike extraction is unchanged.
PARAMETERS
# windowHalfLength
Median high-pass window half length; sets the lower cutoff (identical to ndm_hipass). Determines the lower cutoff frequency.
# lowpassCutoff
Upper cutoff frequency, in Hz (e.g. 6000). Attenuates high-frequency noise above the spike band. Must be below the Nyquist frequency.
# lowpassHalfLength
FIR low-pass half length in samples; the filter has 2*lowpassHalfLength+1 taps, and a larger value gives a sharper transition (optional, default 32).
# chunkSize
Number of bytes to process per pass (optional; used to tune file I/O throughput).
